caption: The drawing features a stylized potted plant with two birds and a hanging flower. The pot is trapezoidal in shape, colored brown with a red border and red dots, and rests on two small yellow feet. Green leafy stems rise from the pot, filling most of the vertical space. Perched on different branches are two birds: the lower bird is red on its chest and back with yellow wings and legs, and a black beak and tail, while the upper bird is predominantly yellow with a brown wing, black tail and beak, and red near its throat. To the right of the upper bird, a large, ornate flower with hanging petals is depicted. The flower has red, green, and black sections as well as yellow interior details. The background of the drawing is beige. Below the drawing, text reads: "FROM A BAPTISMAL CERTIFICATE 1841," and smaller text at the bottom notes "FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA, PLATE No. 12" and "INDEX OF AMERICAN DESIGN PENNA ART PROJECT W.P.A."
title: Plate 12: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
